title: Ace Attorney - Cross Examination System (Battle System Repurpose)

posts.author: COWLARIAN
posts.body: So i've recently got my hooves again on the RPG Maker XP engine, and i wanted to make a game that took from the Ace Attorney series with us being able to present and check our own evidence when needed as well as pressing the suspect and asking to dwell more in the aspects of their testimony, if i recall it right this system is rather simple to do in other engines, the press button just prints another text depending on which text window we're on, as well as the back and foward buttons just making us scroll through the text, my first guess was to re-purpose the battle system, since the menus would make for the best option, it has numerous windows and we can check for objects, but i can't seem to get it right, may i ask, "How can i implement this system into the project?" (it doesn't have to be in the battle system, i would be happy to implement it at all"

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: Wouldn't it effectively be a picture menu where you select a choice > cutscene plays? I don't see any reason to use the battle system.

posts.body:

I don't know what scripts are available for XP so you would have to search yourself, but you would just find a gauge bar script that displays variables as pictures.
You would just have a max health variable and a current health variable, and every time you made the wrong choice subtract one from the current health variable.
